warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Front: the brand is a script logo reading 'The Bruery' with a registered-trademark symbol, set in mixed case, not capitals.

Two other names are printed on the front. 'BLACK TUESDAY' over 'PRIVATE BARREL' is the largest text on the label, set in display capitals across the middle at a 78-row cap height; 'Total Wine & More' is at the bottom, the retailer the release was bottled for. The reading above is the script logo at the top, which is in the brand position and carries the registered-trademark symbol; BLACK TUESDAY is the beer's own name and is the other candidate.

Front carries one line, 'ALC. 20.3% BY VOL. 12.7 FL. OZ.'; the alcohol wording and the net-contents wording are both taken from it. The label prints the fluid-ounce figure only, with no millilitre equivalent.
Back repeats the alcohol statement beside a glass icon as 'ALC. 20.3%' over 'by vol.' in lower case.

Warning is on the back, body justified in capitals across eight lines; the heading 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' is bold capitals and runs in at the head of the first line. The line count was measured rather than judged by eye: the back is light text on black, so ink is grey above 140, and over x 248-711 the rows below the rule at y 760 give eight bands on a 34-row pitch - y 796-819, 830-848, 864-882, 898-916, 932-955, 967-985, 1001-1019 and 1035-1053.
